• Are you passionate about regulatory processes and ensuring they work effectively across the product lifecycle?

Do you thrive in a structured, project-driven environment where your attention to detail and ability to create overview makes a real impact?

If you enjoy connecting the dots between processes, systems, documentation, and people, and occasionally asking "does this actually make sense?", you might fit right in.

We are looking for a Global Process Lead – Regulatory Affairs to join our Global Regulatory Affairs organization at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark.

You will become part of a collaborative and highly engaged team, working closely with stakeholders across functions and geographies. As Process Owner, you will help shape and develop regulatory processes across the product lifecycle and have real influence on how we work globally.

You will ensure that requirements, systems, documentation, and stakeholders work together in practice, not just on paper, while contributing to the implementation of a new Product Lifecycle Management system.

You will work across key Regulatory Affairs process areas, including labeling, product registration, and regulatory intelligence.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Act as Process Owner for the relevant regulatory process and ensure that it supports regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with related processes across the product lifecycle

• Ensure that the regulatory process remains effective, connected, and fit for purpose throughout the transition to a new lifecycle management system, while identifying opportunities for improvement

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of relevant QMS documentation and ensure consistency between process requirements and operational ways of working

• Identify dependencies, resolve gaps, and ensure alignment across functions and lifecycle stages

• Work closely with SMEs, Global Process Owners, and other stakeholders to align processes, responsibilities, interfaces, and supporting data requirements

• Participate in internal and external audits as Process Owner and explain how the process is governed, implemented, and maintained

• Support workshops, training, and change management activities to ensure consistent understanding and application of the process

**About You

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we know the perfect profile cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you bring many of the following:

• A relevant academic degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or similar, along with experience working within Regulatory Affairs in a regulated industry such as medical devices or pharma

• You have a good understanding of regulatory processes and how they support products throughout the product lifecycle

• Experience with process ownership and process development in a regulated environment is a strong advantage

• Ability to shape and improve complex regulatory processes while ensuring alignment across functions and lifecycle stages

• A basic understanding of how systems support regulatory processes and data flows throughout the product lifecycle

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to create alignment across functions and organizational levels

• A structured and pragmatic approach, combined with strong analytical and communication skills

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**When to apply

**As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply as soon as possible. We will invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis so there is no need to hesitate.

If you have any questions about the position, you can contact Marianne Høy, Head of EndoIntelligence, Compliance and Processes at mahh@ambu.com.

3Shape is opening a new position in R&D for an experienced specialist who can help our organization make practical, everyday use of AI across engineering workflows. You will work closely with mechanical, electronics, and software teams to turn existing AI capabilities into reliable tools, assistants, and workflows that improve how engineers work.

This new role in our hardware R&D organization focuses on applying and integrating AI and LLM-based tools into engineering environments — not on developing new AI models. The intention being to save time, improve documentation quality, support better engineering decisions, and make engineering knowledge easier to find and reuse. You will help identify valuable use cases, build scalable internal solutions, and support adoption so the tools become trusted parts of daily engineering work.

What you will work on

You will develop and deploy AI-enabled tools such as chatbots, engineering assistants, reusable prompt workflows, and lightweight internal services. A key part of the role is to connect AI solutions to the tools and knowledge sources engineers already use, such as Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, Azure, Confluence, PLM, SolidWorks, Altium or Altium 365, LabVIEW, TestStand, PowerBI, databases, and structured data files.

You will work closely with engineering teams to understand their needs, then prototype, integrate, document, and mature solutions together with IT and security colleagues. A good solution is useful, secure, maintainable, and adopted because it solves a real problem or makes an existing workflow faster, easier, or more reliable.

Your profile

• 
Experience turning AI/LLM capabilities, eg Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar tools, into practical workflows, assistants, or internal services

• 
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in engineering, computer science, IT, or a similar field

• 
Hands-on experience with APIs, automation, and backend development, for example in Python, C#, Rust, or similar languages to connect tools

• 
Familiarity with engineering environments and tools such as Git, CAD/PLM systems, documentation platforms, test systems, databases, or data visualization tools

• 
Ability to work close to engineers, understand concrete pain points, and translate them into secure, maintainable technical solutions

• 
Pragmatic mindset with focus on practical improvements, enterprise security and IP protection, and adoption in everyday engineering work

Join us in shaping a company culture that makes Monday mornings worth it.

At 3Shape, you will join an international R&D environment in central Copenhagen, working close to advanced hardware, software, and engineering teams developing products that help improve dental care globally. You will have the opportunity to shape how AI is used in engineering practice and see your solutions make a direct difference for colleagues.

We are a vibrant, visionary, and international place to work. But most of all, we are a diverse group of over 50 different nationalities who all contribute to a thriving company culture. We partake in social clubs, monthly social activities, and various in-team activities as well. If that’s not enough, then add on:

• 
Central Copenhagen location

• 
3Shape is a globally recognized tech company.

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and a delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
A joint purpose: to enable dentists to provide superior dental care to every patient, every time.

Apply Now

Be part of a team redefining treatment and care in a meaningful industry. We encourage all qualified professionals who are passionate about building high-performance medical solutions to apply.

Applicants will be reviewed continuously; however, we plan on conducting interviews in August.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

**Technical Fluency

**

• You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What This Role Is Not

**This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We can offer :

**

• Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• A competitive salary and benefits package.

• A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

**Private markets are being transformed — and you could be at the center of it.

**The gap between institutional grade private market tools and the technology that powers them has never been bigger. Trillions of dollars flow through private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real assets, yet the software managing this capital often lags a decade behind. SimCorp is changing that.

We're a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to modernize the private market ecosystem for institutional investors with cross-asset portfolios. We're scaling fast, our customers are the best in the world, and we're looking for a world-class Product Manager to help us build what comes next.

**If you understand the nuances of Private Markets, have a deep empathy for the professionals navigating this space, and know how to turn complexity into elegant software, we need to talk.

****WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a key component of product management for Private Markets, you will own the product strategy and execution alongside our engineering team. You will sit at the intersection of finance and technology translating the intricate workflows of private market professionals into intuitive, powerful software that delights users and drives business outcomes.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll work directly with the leadership, clients, market participants, engineering, sales and go-to-market teams, and you'll have real ownership over a product area that is central to our company's growth. You will shape the roadmap, define priorities, and rally a talented team of engineers and designers around a shared vision.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Orchestrate high-stakes product demonstrations, executive roundtables, and client conferences to evangelize the solution and secure stakeholder buy-in across diverse audiences.

• Define, own and evolve the product roadmap for our private markets platform, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term strategic vision.

• Be the primary point of contact, the go-to person for private markets and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategically own, manage and prioritize the product backlog in lockstep with Leadership, balancing technical debt with high-value strategic investments to ensure seamless delivery.

• Deeply immerse yourself in the workflows of private markets - conducting interviews, shadowing users, and synthesizing feedback into actionable insights.

• Write crisp, well-reasoned product specifications and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship high-quality features on time.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to author comprehensive user features and stories, establishing rigorous acceptance criteria to ensure all deliverables meet 'Definition of Ready' and 'Definition of Done' standards in the acceptance of deliverables.

• Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate outcomes, iterate quickly, and communicate results to stakeholders.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand market gaps, competitive dynamics, and the evolving needs of our customer base.

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI and automation into core workflows — making complex workflows faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and the 'why' behind every decision.

• Stay ahead of regulatory developments, market trends, and competitive shifts in the private markets technology landscape.

• Represent the voice of the customer in every product decision — advocating relentlessly for user experience without sacrificing business viability.

**Who You Are

**You're not just a product manager, you're a private market expert who happens to love building software. You've spent time in or around private markets and you feel the pain points firsthand. You're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you see a workflow for the first time and immediately start mentally redesigning it. You are rigorous in your thinking, persuasive in your communication, and relentless in your follow-through.

You thrive in ambiguity. You can take a messy problem, break it down into its component parts, and build consensus around a path forward without needing every answer handed to you. You care about craft: a half-built feature or a confusing UX genuinely bothers you. And you're a collaborator at heart, you know that great products are built by great teams, and you know how to bring out the best in the people around you.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years product management experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS or fintech.

• Meaningful exposure to private markets, whether through prior work at a PE firm, fund administrator, placement agent, LP, or financial software company serving these markets.

• Demonstrated track record of successfully launching products and features that users love and that drive measurable business results.

• Strong understanding of private asset structures, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, and related workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can write a tight one-pager and present to a room of skeptical executives with equal confidence and are not afraid to use AI.

• Proficiency in working with data: you're comfortable analyzing usage metrics and building dashboards to support your decisions.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams in an agile environment; familiarity with modern development practices is a plus.

• High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly with customers, engineers, and senior leadership alike.

• A genuine curiosity about technology and its role in reshaping financial services.

• Experience engaging proactively with clients and stakeholders to solicit input for user stories.

• Broad knowledge of the Alternative Investment marketplace and system vendors.

• Experience with SimCorp Dimension® (advantageous but not required).

• Proven track record in roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, Engineering, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Consultant within software development.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills focused on business outcomes and complete product offers.

• Ability to encourage, motivate, and influence teams and peers; contribute to improvements across the community.

• Understanding of how great products are built and deliver value to clients.

• Creative and inquisitive mindset with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Degree in Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or a related field (preferred).

**Why Join Us

**

• Meaningful ownership — your decisions will shape a platform used by some of the world’s most sophisticated investors, and your work will have visible, lasting impact.

• A culture built on trust, autonomy, and deep collaboration.

• A leadership team with deep domain expertise, proven execution experience, and a genuine commitment to building an exceptional, humancentered culture.

• The opportunity to build category defining technology in a space undergoing massive transformation where your influence won’t just move the product forward, it will help reshape an entire industry.

• A place where craft matters, ideas win on merit, and people are encouraged to think boldly, act decisively, and do the best work of their careers.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Azeta GUITI Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not just optional, it is essential.

Scientific Software Engineer for Research Software Engineering Group

The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of Europe’s largest research infrastructure projects and is building the world’s most powerful neutron source. Through cutting-edge science and technology, ESS will enable discoveries that advance our understanding of materials, energy, health, and the environment.

About the role

The Research Software Engineering (RSE) group develops and maintains critical software systems that make neutron scattering experiments at ESS possible and successful.

As a Scientific Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of key platforms supporting the scientific user journey, including the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information systems. You will work closely with scientists, software engineers, and stakeholders across ESS to gather requirements, understand user needs, and develop robust software solutions that integrate seamlessly with the wider ESS ecosystem.

The RSE group uses modern web technologies and software engineering practices to deliver high-quality software with a long operational lifetime. In addition, the group is expanding its focus on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that can enhance the scientific user experience. As part of this effort, you will contribute to new AI-related initiatives and help establish RSE as a centre of expertise and development for AI applications within the Science Directorate.

This position is well suited for an experienced software engineer with a strong technical foundation, excellent collaboration skills, and a passion for building software that enables world-class scientific research.

Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain software systems supporting the scientific user journey at ESS.

• Contribute to the development of the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information management systems.

• Gather, analyse, and refine requirements from scientific and technical stakeholders across ESS.

• Design and implement integrations between RSE applications and other ESS services and platforms.

• Apply modern software engineering practices to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions.

• Contribute to technical and process improvements within the SIMS group.

• Participate in AI and Machine Learning initiatives supporting the Science Directorate.

• Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and international partners to develop innovative solutions for scientific computing and data management.

• Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the team when appropriate.

• Contribute to software architecture discussions and technology decisions within the group.

Required qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Typically 4-7 years of relevant professional experience in software development.

• Experience developing modern web applications and services.

• Strong programming skills and experience with modern software development practices.

• Experience gathering requirements and working directly with stakeholders and end users.

• Experience designing and implementing integrations between complex software systems.

• Ability to work independently and manage technical tasks and projects with limited supervision.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable qualifications

• Experience working with scientific software, research infrastructures, or data-intensive environments.

• Experience with cloud-based services and distributed systems.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies and their practical application.

• Experience with user-facing platforms, portals, or information management systems.

• Familiarity with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and container technologies.

• Experience working in international and multidisciplinary environments.

• Experience contributing to open-source software projects.

What we offer

DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.

You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer flexible working conditions, opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large-scale experiments.

Benefits include 25 + 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.

This is a full-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.

Learn more about living and working in Scandinavia: https://ess.eu/living-working-scandinavia

For further information

For information about the position, contact the Group Leader for SIMS, Fredrik Bolmsten at Fredrik.bolmsten@ess.eu.

For recruitment-related questions, contact Recruitment Officer Janne Erwolter at janne.erwolter@ess.eu.

Application deadline

Please submit your application no later than November 5, 2026.

About the position

Join MicroTech Software to build cutting-edge AI-powered tools for insurance professionals. Work on production RAG chatbots, agentic workflows, and voice-to-workflow capabilities.

At MicroTech Software we build cutting edge AI-powered tools that help insurance professionals answer complex questions faster and with greater confidence. Our flagship product is a production RAG chatbot used daily by insurance workers, and we are actively pushing its architecture in several new directions at once using the newest models. Your reference will be our AI Lead. We are looking for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who has reached the point where writing good code is no longer the hard part — and who is ready to take on the harder questions: which approach to use, how to structure a system for long-term maintainability, and where to invest engineering time to get the most impact. You will work in a team with a very advanced team lead whom you can expect to learn from and alongside one or more junior engineers and be expected to help set the direction of their work as well as your own.

Responsibilities

• Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack — retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries, data flow — and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Participate in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, translating vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost, and make the case for addressing it

• Navigate an on-prem transition

• Design and lead the migration of a cloud-dependent LLM stack to a fully local alternative: self-hosted models, local embedding, and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality; understand the trade-offs in latency, accuracy, and hardware requirements

• Contribute to a RAG → GraphRAG transition: build a knowledge graph and integrate it into an existing RAG pipeline

• Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools, and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns, and failure handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

• Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Contribute to the design of a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps, and assess the feasibility of fine-tuning or model selection approaches

• Design the integration points carefully — latency, error handling, data privacy — so voice becomes a first-class input channel

We are looking for someone who can say yes to

Must-have

• 2–4 years of production Python engineering experience, including async code, clean architecture patterns, and testable codebases

• Direct experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain or similar) in a shipped product or serious project

• Solid understanding of RAG systems: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search, retrieval quality evaluation

• Familiarity with vector databases — pgvector, Chroma, Weaviate, Pinecone, or equivalent

• Comfortable owning a FastAPI service end-to-end: schema design, error handling, auth, containerization, deployment

• Ability to reason about architectural trade-offs and communicate them clearly

Strong advantages

• Hands-on experience designing or running local LLM inference — Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp — in a real rather than toy context

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs — ontology building, knowledge extraction, RAG integration

• Experience with agentic frameworks: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom tool-use / planning loops in production

• Speech-to-text pipeline work — Whisper, Deepgram, Speechmatics, or comparable local STT — especially on non-English languages

• Experience designing hybrid retrieval systems (dense + sparse, BM25 + vector) and re-ranking with cross-encoders

• Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing tools (Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or similar)

• Exposure to multilingual NLP, particularly Danish or other Nordic languages

Nice to have

• Knowledge of regulated-industry data handling, GDPR, or EU AI Act compliance considerations

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred): managed services, container registries, CI/CD

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical Construction Project Manager (Mechanical OR)- Data Centres
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

Turner & Townsend is looking for a Senior Mechanical Construction Project Manager to oversee the pre-construction, construction, commissioning, and close-out phases of a hyperscale, state of the art data center project for a global technology client onsite in Fredericia, Denmark.

This role is key in ensuring the successful delivery of a state-of-the-art facility, with a focus on mechanical systems and engineering.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and manage the mechanical pre-construction activities, including constructability in design, procurement and contracts, project planning, budget planning is delivered on time and to the highest quality standards.

• Lead and manage the mechanical construction activities, ensuring the project is delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

• Oversee mechanical system installations, including HVAC, mechanical, plumbing, fire protection, and associated systems.

• Ensure that the mechanical designs are aligned with the overall design intent and client expectations, managing any issues that arise during construction.

Pre-Construction Phase Oversight:

• Oversee and assist the design team in constructability and localization in the design focusing mainly on the mechanical systems but assist and collaboration with other disciplines.

• Ensure compliance with building codes, regulations, and safety protocols are adhered to.

• Provide technical guidance on mechanical system installations, ensuring that contract documents and specifications are relevant to the region.

• Play a pivotal role in the procurement of contractors and vendor.

Construction Phase Oversight:

• Manage and supervise mechanical subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers, ensuring that work is completed to specification and safety standards.

• Full-time on-site presence to conduct inspections and supervise construction activities.

• Ensure construction activities are in full compliance with building codes, regulations, and safety protocols.

• Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting on mechanical system installations, ensuring that all work is completed as per the contract documents and specifications.

• Manage health and safety on site.

Commissioning & Handover:

• Oversee the commissioning process of mechanical systems to ensure all systems are fully operational and meet performance criteria.

• Lead the mechanical system testing and commissioning process, ensuring all relevant documentation (test reports, as-builts, O&M manuals) are accurate and handed over to the client.

• Assist in the final project closeout and ensure the mechanical systems are handed over seamlessly to the client.

Owner’s Representation:

• Act as the primary point of contact between the client and the construction team for mechanical-related issues.

• Provide advice and recommendations to the client, ensuring their interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle.

• Proactively identify and manage risks related to mechanical systems and recommend mitigation strategies.

Quality Control & Compliance:

• Ensure all mechanical work adheres to quality standards and local regulations.

• Review and approve subcontractor invoices and work schedules.

• Conduct site safety audits and ensure that work is being performed in compliance with all health and safety standards.

Budget & Schedule Management:

• Monitor and report on the progress of mechanical work against the project schedule and budget.

• Track project costs, identifying and addressing cost overruns or delays.

• Ensure that changes in scope are managed efficiently, with appropriate documentation and approval processes in place.

Education:

• A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., PMP, LEED) are a plus.

Experience:

At Genmab, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients through innovative antibody-based medicines. To support our biologics pipeline and portfolio, we are looking for a CMC Senior Stability Specialist in the CMC Stability department to strengthen our CMC organization with a focus on life-cycle-management activities.

**The Role and Department

**As CMC Senior Stability Specialist, you will be part of the CMC Stability department organized in CMC Development and Manufacturing. The CMC Stability department supports the Genmab portfolio from early CMC development projects to commercial products. Additionally, you will be part of and collaborate with CMC project teams

You will join a department of eight skilled and dedicated employees. In the role, you will be responsible for stability, governance of products and collaborate closely with colleagues within the department, across CMC, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Supply, and with external partners at CDMO’s/CMO’s in a highly matrixed, international environment.

Besides having extended experience with biologics and stability, the ideal candidate is statistically well-founded and can help advance the department’s data-handling capabilities.

This position will report to the Head of Department, CMC Stability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as stability subject matter expert supporting Genmab’s biologics products.

• Ensure alignment and oversight of stability activities performed at external partners, CDMO’s/CMO’s, and internal laboratories.

• Ensure scientifically sound and regulatory-compliant stability approaches aligned with ICH guidelines and regulations.

• Perform and oversee statistical evaluation of stability data, including data handling, trend analysis and shelf-life determination.

• Author and review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, BLA/MAA, variations).

• Support health authority interactions, e.g. be part of the request for information processes for topics related to stability.

• Be part of establishing a mature life-cycle-management set-up for commercial products.

**Requirements

**

• PhD or MSc in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, statistics, or related discipline.

• Significant experience (typically 7+ years) within CMC stability for biologics and strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, including Q1A–Q1E, Q5C, and Q6B.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of stability for marketed biologics/clinical biological products according to current requirements and best industrial practices.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in statistical methods applied to stability data (e.g. regression analysis, pooling, trend analysis).

• Experience working and interacting with CDMO’s/CMO’s.

• Experience with supporting global regulatory submissions.

• Ability to translate complex scientific and statistical data into clear regulatory and business recommendations.

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• You seek and have demonstrated ability to collaborate with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to support product development programs.

• You have a structured and analytical approach when solving problems.

• Flair for IT and user software to monitor stability.

• You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and define steps needed to achieve project and department goals.

• You can work successfully and with integrity in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.

**What You Can Expect At Genmab

**

• A high-impact role in a science-driven organization focused on patients.

• A collaborative and inclusive culture with strong cross-functional teamwork.

• Opportunities to shape strategy and contribute to key project decisions.

• Professional growth in a global biologics company with a strong pipeline.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

The Opportunity

Every day, thousands of manufacturers rely on Secomea's Secure Remote Access platform to securely connect engineers with the industrial equipment that keeps factories, utilities, and critical infrastructure running.

Secomea is entering its next phase of accelerated growth. Building on strong commercial momentum, the company is now strengthening its engineering teams as a strategic foundation for further growth.

We're hiring an Engineering Team Lead for one of our Cloud teams, reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people leadership.

This is a role with significant influence in a growing international company where initiative, technical excellence, accountability, and impact matter.

What You'll Do

As Engineering Team Lead, you'll lead one of the engineering teams building the customer-facing heart of our cloud layer that brings together identity, governance, secure access, APIs, and user experience into a seamless experience trusted by industrial organizations worldwide. It enables enterprise IT to centrally govern secure access while allowing technicians to quickly find, access, and work with the industrial resources they're responsible for.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role where leadership is an addition to engineering—not a move away from it. You'll spend much of your time designing, coding, reviewing code, solving complex technical problems, contributing to architectural decisions, and supporting production operations while serving as the direct people leader for your team.

You will work closely with UX, Product Management, and engineering teams across the platform to deliver intuitive user experience while maintaining the enterprise-grade governance, security, and reliability that industrial customers expect.

You'll solve challenging engineering problems spanning distributed cloud systems, APIs, identity, governance, scalability, observability, security, and user experience.

As a people leader, you will coach and support team members through regular feedback, development discussions, hiring activities, and performance management. You will drive engineering excellence through sound architecture, high code quality, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role requires both technical depth and the ability to create clarity, build trust, and help a team perform at a high level.

You will be part of Secomea's engineering leadership community, working closely with other Team Leads and Engineering Managers to evolve our technology organization, engineering practices, and technical direction.

What We’re Looking For

You may already be leading a team, or you may be a senior engineer who naturally takes ownership, mentors colleagues, and drives technical initiatives. In either case, you are motivated by helping people succeed and understand that strong teams are built through trust, communication, and shared accountability.

You have a strong software engineering background and significant experience building distributed software systems using modern technologies such as .NET and Azure. More importantly, you're curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new technologies as products and platforms evolve.

Most importantly, we are looking for a strong team player who thrives in a rapidly growing environment and is energized by combining deep technical work with leading and inspiring people.

Experience We Value

You don't need to tick every box below, but you should bring a solid foundation in .NET and modern cloud technologies.

Core Skills

• Strong experience with C# and .NET

• Ability and curiosity to quickly master new technologies

• Experience with modern databases, preferably document databases

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in production settings

• Unit and integration testing — xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest; comfortable with TDD or BDD

• Ability to work closely with UX and Product Management to translate customer needs into intuitive product experiences

Cloud Skills

• Experience designing scalable, high-performance distributed systems, including performance analysis and optimization.

• Experience designing, deploying, and operating distributed applications in public cloud environments. Experience with Azure is an advantage. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.

• Experience designing secure, scalable, and intuitive APIs.

Security and OT Knowledge

• Core security concepts — encryption, authentication, and authorization for web applications and APIs.

• Operational Technology (preferred) — familiarity with OT protocols such as Modbus, OPC UA, or MQTT, and the unique security challenges of ICS and SCADA environments.

Leadership Qualifications

• Proven experience as a senior technical contributor with the ability and desire to remain hands-on while leading others.

• You may already be leading a team, mentoring junior engineers, acting as a Staff Engineer, or simply be the person others naturally turn to for technical guidance. We care more about your ability to help others succeed than about previous management titles.

Just as important, you:

• Take ownership and drive tasks to completion

• Proactively identify gaps, risks, and improvements.

• Translate high-level goals into concrete technical outcomes

• Care about building robust systems that are stable and perform reliably in the real world.

You do not need to meet every requirement to be successful in the role. We value curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn as highly as specific technical experience.

About Secomea

Secomea is a global leader in Operational Technology (OT) and secure remote access solutions for industrial environments. We help manufacturers, machine builders, and system integrators securely connect, monitor, and manage industrial equipment around the world.

Founded in Denmark in 2008, Secomea has spent more than fifteen years helping organizations enable protected access to their critical industrial infrastructure while supporting efficient and secure operations. Today, we serve customers globally through our offices in Denmark, the United States, Japan, and China, through a network of partners across more than 70 countries.

As cybersecurity and compliance become increasingly critical to industrial operations, our mission remains simple: Protecting the factory floor.

Why Join Secomea?

This role combines technical depth, product thinking, architectural influence, and people leadership in equal measure.

You'll help shape the customer-facing heart of Secomea's cloud layer, solving engineering challenges where distributed systems, identity, security, APIs, and user experience come together. Success isn't measured only by the quality of the software you build, but by how naturally enterprise governance and technician productivity work together.

As a Team Lead, you'll have genuine influence. You'll help shape the technical direction of the cloud layer, grow an experienced engineering team, and work closely with Product Management, UX, and fellow engineering leaders to define how the cloud layer evolves. You'll remain close to technology while helping others succeed.

Perhaps most importantly, your work has a tangible impact. Every improvement your team delivers helps manufacturers and critical infrastructure operators securely connect the people who keep factories, utilities, and essential infrastructure running. It's engineering where technical excellence directly improves how people work in the real world.

You'll join an engineering organization that's large enough to build globally trusted products, yet small enough that your technical decisions, leadership, and ideas genuinely shape the future of both the product and the company.

How To Apply

Ready to take the next step?

Submit your CV and let’s start the conversation. We are more interested in meeting the right person than finding someone who checks every box. If you are excited about leading talented engineers while remaining deeply involved in building secure, high-performance systems, we would love to hear from you.
